summary.text: Dick Thackston is a Republican state representative from Cheshire 12 who has served in the House since 2022 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Thackston is a realtor and Troy selectman who has served on local and regional school boards.

paragraphs.text: Dick Thackston was born in Morristown, New Jersey, and earned a bachelor's degree from George Mason University in 1982.
His career experience includes working as a realtor.

In a 2024 Ballotpedia survey, Thackston described himself as a resident of Troy for more than 30 years and said he served on the Monadnock Regional School Board from 1996 to 2013, as Troy town moderator from 2014 to 2018, and as a Troy selectman from 2018.
He said he chaired the Monadnock Regional School Board from 2010 to 2013 and the Troy Board of Selectmen from 2018 to 2023.
In the same survey, Thackston named taxation, education, rule of law and due process, parental rights, and individual liberty and responsibility as policy areas he is passionate about.
He wrote that local control of planning and zoning should be preserved and that market forces should primarily address housing availability.
